description: The public download page of the Ventora phone app (SPEC_ECRANE_SMS §9), at app.ventora-hub.com/telefon — no account needed. In the 6 languages, light and dark, at 1280, 820 and 390. Built from Logo, LanguageSwitcher, ThemeSwitcher, Button, Notice, Tabs / Select and Icon; the QR is a placeholder drawn dark on light in both themes so phones can read it.
